price_daily_range_chk.name: price_daily_range_chk
price_daily_range_chk.value: ("price_daily"."value_low" IS NULL OR "price_daily"."value_mid" >= "price_daily"."value_low") AND ("price_daily"."value_high" IS NULL OR "price_daily"."value_mid" <= "price_daily"."value_high")

content_forecast_period_chk.name: content_forecast_period_chk
content_forecast_period_chk.value: ("content"."kind" <> 'forecast') OR ("content"."period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "content"."period_end" IS NOT NULL AND "content"."period_end" >= "content"."period_start")

opportunity_price_range_chk.name: opportunity_price_range_chk
opportunity_price_range_chk.value: "opportunity"."price_min" IS NULL OR "opportunity"."price_max" IS NULL OR "opportunity"."price_min" <= "opportunity"."price_max"
